description: AI-IMAGE + MESH RENDER pipeline — direct, queue, and gate externally-painted images and externally-sculpted meshes (the mesh quartet parks a greybox for Meshy / Tripo / Hunyuan3D…): render packets for image-outcome / comic / character-sheet sketches, the durable request → pull → submit → accept / reject worker loop, and binding finished PNGs and character sheets back onto their sketches. Open for 'have the image model paint this', 'an AI-painted portrait rendered by an image model', 'run the render queue', 'accept that render'.

args.description: Arguments for the member tool, exactly as its inputSchema in the pack manual specifies.

tool.description: Member tool to dispatch. OMIT on the first call to open the pack: you get its orientation body plus the member manual (names, descriptions, input schemas).

name: pack_image_render
